defect.description: Eventually runs the condition in a goroutine that sends on an unbuffered checkPassed channel and defers close(checkPassed) on return; when the timer expires first, the deferred close races the in-flight goroutine's send, and the send on the closed channel panics in the condition goroutine, crashing the test binary.
defect.provenance: fix PR #808 (commit f1bd0923): 'Fix panic for Eventually functions'; fixes issues #805 and #835
